summary: Comprehensive testing of bug fixes for SignGuy AI iteration 52. All 6 features/fixes verified working: 1) Invoice line_items now properly copied from job.line_items, 2) Quick Add Job/Quote buttons in customer modal, 3) Search functionality on Jobs/Invoices/Webstores pages, 4) Job title dark blue text visible on Job Details page.

invoice_line_items_from_job.description: POST /api/invoices/from-job/{job_id} now correctly copies line_items from job.line_items. Tested with job having 2 line items - invoice created with same items and correct total ($250.00).

quick_add_job_button.description: Quick Add Job button visible in customer detail modal. Clicking navigates to /jobs and opens New Job dialog with customer pre-selected.

quick_add_quote_button.description: Quick Add Quote button visible in customer detail modal next to Quick Add Job button.

jobs_search.description: Search input on Jobs page works. Typing 'Invoice' filtered jobs from 10 to 1 matching result. Clearing search restores all jobs.

invoices_search.description: Search input on Invoices page visible and functional. Uses data-testid='invoice-search-input'.

webstores_search.description: Search input on Webstores page visible and functional. Uses data-testid='webstore-search-input'.

job_title_visibility.description: Job title on Job Details page displays in dark blue text (text-[#0D4F8B]) which is clearly visible on white card background. No more white-on-white issue.

critical_code_review_comments: invoices.py create_invoice_from_job correctly checks job_items collection first, then falls back to job.line_items - proper handling
Jobs.js search filter uses name, customer name, and description for matching - comprehensive search
Invoices.js search filter includes customer name, job name, invoice number, and notes - comprehensive search
Webstores.js search filter includes store name, owner name, and description - comprehensive search
Customers.js Quick Add buttons pass type=job or type=quote via URL params to Jobs page
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed customer, job, and invoice created during backend tests - cleaned up after test
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested bug fixes verified working. Invoice line items feature uses fallback logic: 1) check job_items collection, 2) check job.line_items array, 3) use job subtotal/quote total. Search inputs use data-testid pattern: job-search-input, invoice-search-input, webstore-search-input. Quick Add buttons in customer modal navigate to /jobs?new=true&customer_id=X&type=job|quote.
